name: Fallen
description: When you die, your items don't scatter across the ground and vanish. Instead your body stays where you fell — a corpse wearing your skin — holding everything you were carrying, plus your XP. Walk back and right-click to reclaim your gear (sneak-right-click grabs it all at once). Corpses are yours to loot during a grace period, then anyone can, and if left too long they drop their contents so nothing is ever truly lost. Original code and assets.
